title: Choose the visual world for Rocket
question: The roll assigned The Rocket Line. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. All options keep Rocket's purple, logo and white-dominant brief.

options.label: The Rocket Line
options.lineage: Dhaka Metro Rail wayfinding: white enamel signage, one line colour, numbered stations
options.thesis: Rocket as a nationwide line: every service, agent and ATM is a stop on one purple route you can always read.
options.viewport: A clean white field where a thick purple line sweeps from the headline into the real app on a phone, with stops along it labelled Cash In, Send Money, Pay and Cash Out, and Download Rocket plus *322# as the boarding actions.
options.risk: If the line is applied as a decorative squiggle rather than the actual navigation and step logic, it reads as clip-art.

raised.raise: One law of motion: every animation travels along the line's direction, as money moves, never random floats.
Plain literal naming: every stop is named exactly what it does, in Bangla and English, no marketing names.
Preview before you board: selecting a service shows the real app screen for it before you leave the page.
Everything measured on one strict 12-column grid; the line snaps to column edges, nothing floats off-grid.
Every stop is addressable: each service state has its own URL, so a shared link opens that exact service.

options.label: Taka Security Print
options.lineage: Bangladeshi taka banknote engraving: guilloche rosettes, microtext, watermark
options.thesis: The site is printed like money itself: white security paper, purple guilloche and microtext that proves authenticity.
options.viewport: A white note-like field with a large purple guilloche rosette framing the app phone, headline set like a denomination.
options.risk: Familiar fintech move; fine engraving can look busy on low-end phones and fight the white-dominant brief.

options.label: Orienteering Course
options.thesis: White runnable ground with a purple course riding over everything: numbered controls walk you to an account.
options.viewport: A white contour field with a purple numbered course from 'Get the app' to 'Account active'.
options.case: Holds product clarity (numbered controls = steps); loses audience identification, few Bangladeshi users know orienteering.
options.risk: Contour texture reads as topographic decoration to anyone outside the sport.

options.label: Gravity-Rain Garden
options.thesis: Money as coloured rain obeying each cloud's gravity.
options.viewport: A dusk garden with rains falling toward services.
options.case: Loses both axes: surreal physics obscures a bank's plain facts.

options.label: Industrial Quote Grammar
options.thesis: Every zone labelled with its literal quoted name.
options.case: Loses both: streetwear irony undercuts a bank's trust.
options.risk: Hazard stripes read as warnings everywhere.

options.label: Arcade Marquee Row
options.thesis: One lit cabinet per service down a dark aisle.
options.viewport: A dark aisle of glowing service cabinets.
options.case: Loses both: dark neon contradicts the white brief and banking trust.

options.label: Oscilloscope Bench
options.thesis: Transactions as phosphor traces on a graticule.
options.viewport: A green trace on black glass.
options.case: Loses both: lab instrument, not everyday banking.
options.kept: Everything measured on one strict grid.

options.label: HyperCard Stack
options.case: Loses both: drops Rocket's purple identity entirely.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The MFS website as bKash and peers ship it, in Rocket purple, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline left, app phone right, a service icon row below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
